answerCheck.reason: One suspension identifies only a line containing the center of gravity. Two suitably chosen suspensions give distinct lines whose unique intersection locates it.
The centroid lies on the median from A. Since the suspension line passes through both A and the centroid, it is that median and intersects BC at its midpoint.
